claims: The London City Lionesses held Chelsea to a 1-1 draw in the Women’s Super League on March 21, 2026.
Johanna Rytting Kaneryd opened the scoring for Chelsea.
Isobel Goodwin scored a late equalizer for the London City Lionesses.
The match took place at The Den.
Chelsea fielded their youngest starting XI of the season with an average age of 23 years, 198 days.
